name: [Negative] Failure to Withdraw/Refund FD
description: Users have experienced difficulties in withdrawing or getting refunds for their fixed deposits (FDs), with some reporting complete losses of their funds.

name: [Negative] Bond and FD Issues
description: Users report various issues with bonds and fixed deposits (FDs) on the app, including lack of available bond options, incorrect interest rates, and problems with investing and withdrawing funds. They also express dissatisfaction with the customer support team.
